name: net-guard
description: A single enforced egress choke-point for tokenizen's public-facing servers: resolves and validates every outbound host against private/loopback/link-local/metadata ranges, pins the validated IP into the connection (defeating DNS rebinding), and re-validates every redirect hop. The one place an outbound connection is allowed to be made, so no request path can forget the guard.
author: holistis
